title: Solar Panel Test
description: Compare open-circuit and loaded panel voltage readings using a repeatable checklist.

steps.title: Confirm Conditions
steps.instruction: Confirm the panel is illuminated and record notable conditions like shade or cloud cover.

steps.title: Measure Open-Circuit Voltage
steps.instruction: Disconnect the load and capture the panel open-circuit DC voltage.

steps.title: Measure Loaded Voltage
steps.instruction: Reconnect the load and capture the panel voltage under load.

steps.title: Record Result
steps.instruction: Note whether the loaded voltage is reasonable for the panel and conditions.
